If exactly two different moves are played, the players who played the winning move split the pot equally and the others lose their stake: a lone winner gains 2 points net, two winners gain 0.5 each. If all three moves are the same, or all three are different, nobody wins and every stake is returned.
Your goal is to maximise your own total score.
You and Player B share a private chat. Before every round you exchange messages. Player C never sees these messages.
